text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (us-west-2) — 09:12 UTC. Trigger: 5xx_rate > 3% for 3m. Pager: oncall-eng-primary.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T09:05Z by jamal -> rollout/gateway/2026-03-14 (sha: a1b2c3). No automatic rollback.

Priya: i'm paged, taking primary. will triage now. Ken want to be secondary? :wave:

Ken: on secondary. I've got the alert dashboard open. spike started ~09:09, aligns shortly after the deploy.

Priya: quick plan — 1) confirm error signature, 2) check recent deploys & canary, 3) enable fallback routing, 4) if noisy pages block triage, request temporary alert threshold change.

Jamal: that was my deploy — I'm standing by. I rolled a small gateway config change for concurrency heuristics. If it's my change, happy to rollback.

Priya: Jamal — can you post the config diff (or link) here?

Jamal: diff: https://git.internal/redwood/gateway/commit/a1b2c3. main change: reduce default max_inflight from 150 -> 100 for us-west pools.

Sofia: tagging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx (follow the "gateway 5xx" section). key checks: backend health, model subprocess OOMs, and recent config flips.

Priya: logs pulled from the host pool, seeing repeated `model-service` timeouts and a couple of OOM kills in pod logs. suspect resource pressure after concurrency change.

Ken: steps I'm taking now:
1) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes (hotfix)
2) enable traffic fallback to smaller model variant for high-latency requests

Priya: applying fallback routing now. Curl to routing api:```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/route/fallback" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2","from_model":"gptx-3","to_model":"gptx-3-small-fallback","reason":"mitigation-1803456789"}'
```

Priya: fallback enabled, returning 200. Please monitor error rate.

incident-bot: AIM: fallback_route applied by Priya (09:23 UTC).

Ken: scaled pool +2 nodes (autoscaler override). new capacity should be available within ~2m.

Jamal: i'm ready to rollback the gateway config if needed. suggest we hold rollback for 10m to see impact of fallback + scale.

Priya: agreed. watching metrics. 09:30 -> 5xx down to 1.8% but still noisy; paging is spamming secondary on flapping alerts.

Jamal: can we temporarily raise the alert threshold to avoid repeat pages while mitigation stabilizes? propose changing 5xx alert from 3%->5% for 30m. will annotate change in alert history.

Ken: i'm cautious about raising thresholds without stakeholder ok, but we need noise reduction to continue triage. This is an SLO-impacting alert (SLO: 99.9 p99 success). If we raise threshold, we should: a) make it explicit in slack, b) record duration and reason, c) file a follow-up postmortem.

Priya: agreed to those constraints. i'm going to open a temporary alert override in ops-console and notify incident channel.

Priya: creating override now:```
POST /ops/alerts/overrides
{
  "resource":"inference-gateway-us-west-2",
  "metric":"5xx_rate",
  "old_threshold":3.0,
  "new_threshold":5.0,
  "duration_minutes":30,
  "reason":"mitigation and reduce pager noise while scaling + fallback",
  "author":"Priya"
}
```

incident-bot: Alert override created by Priya — expires in 30m (09:58 UTC). Annotation id: ov-20260314-1803456789.

Sofia: please add a reminder to revert if the mitigation fails. Also add a note for customer-impact assessment: estimate % affected and any SLO breach windows.

Priya: noted. i'm starting a quick estimation: current 5xx peak ~3.8% for ~12m. attacker? looks internal. will update with customer impact once stable.

Ken: leaving a pinned checklist (runbook):
- check model OOMs (done)
- check host CPU/mem (ongoing)
- confirm fallback functioning (done)
- monitor ingress latency (ongoing)
- if 5xx persists after scale, rollback gateway change

Priya: after scale + fallback, 5xx steady ~1.2% for last 6m. good. I'm going to handoff coverage for rest of shift to Ken at 20:45 UTC — he'll be primary from that time. I need to driver's meeting at 21:00.

Ken: ack. i'll monitor until 23:00 UTC and escalate to oncall-lead if anything reappears. also will file incident ticket summarizing actions (OV id, rollback decision window, impact estimate).

Jamal: lmk if you want a rollback; happy to roll back the concurrency tweak if issues persist.

Sofia: reminder on process: any temporary alert threshold change needs a followup change in the alerts repo and a post-incident note that includes exact window and rationale.

Priya: creating the incident ticket now: INC-2026-1803456789. Contents: timeline, deploy link, OV id ov-20260314-1803456789, mitigation steps (scale + fallback), temporary threshold raise to 5% for 30m, customer impact estimate: ~3% of requests saw 5xx peak for ~12m, no confirmed data exfil/authorization issues.

Ken: thumbs up. i'll own the followup and confirm alert rule revert at 09:58 UTC or sooner if we revert earlier.

Priya: handing off. Ken will be primary from 20:45 UTC->23:00 UTC. Priya -> Ken :wave: :thumbsup:

Ken: thanks — taking point. file created and i'll update with postmortem draft tomorrow.

incident-bot: Thread closed (mitigation in place). If 5xx spikes again, new alert will open a fresh thread.
